Seraphine.combo: If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you can close the gap, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally's area-of-effect crowd control lands first, save E and activate R immediately. Use R at maximum range or with a wall or bush behind you so Seraphine's catch ability can't interrupt it.
Seraphine.fight: Close the gap and trade when Seraphine is separated from her allied marksman or right after she uses Seraphine E Beat Drop. Keep your distance while Seraphine still has her catch ability, since Miss Fortune has no ability to escape. Activate Miss Fortune W Strut for trades that need attack speed.
Seraphine.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound. Build magic resistance rather than armor to resist Seraphine's damage. If Seraphine E Beat Drop's stun keeps interrupting Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, buy Quicksilver Sash before other defensive items.
Seraphine.escape: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap. Seraphine has no mobility, so trade then; but if E slows you, prioritize moving out of its line over engaging.
Seraphine.laning: If Seraphine stands behind a low-health minion, kill it with Miss Fortune Q Double Up to look for bounce damage. For basic-attack poke, alternate between minions and Seraphine to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. When you can't see the enemy jungler's path, don't keep pushing the lane with Q; focus on basic-attack poke.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, use Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up to seek a poke advantage. In late game, Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone, so fight behind your team.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the left and right to keep Seraphine R Encore from extending its range through your allies. Block the enemy approach with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time when your team has stopped the engage and the enemies bunch up in one direction. If R is unavailable, block the engage with E and fight with basic attacks.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets.

Draven.laning: If Draven stands behind a low-health front minion, kill it with Miss Fortune Q Double Up and aim to hit him with the bounce. When you can’t see the enemy jungler’s path, don’t keep pushing with Q; use basic attacks to poke with Miss Fortune P Love Tap instead. If trades are unfavorable, farm safely and don’t give Draven a chance to kill you.
Draven.build: Draven deals mainly physical damage, and Miss Fortune has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Also account for the execute from Draven R Whirling Death when considering your total health.
Draven.combo: Cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain where Draven’s axe will land to slow him. If Draven is immobilized and you can safely maintain Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, follow up with R. If your team lands area crowd control first, save E and cast R immediately.
Draven.escape: Close the gap when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one Draven Q Spinning Axe or fewer. Cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain where an axe will land to block his path to it, and activate Miss Fortune W Strut when trading.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight Draven while he has two Draven Q Spinning Axes; look for a moment when he has one or none. Cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain where an axe will land to make it harder for him to catch, then trade. Use the attack speed from Miss Fortune W Strut during trades.
Draven.phase: Early Draven trades are strong while he maintains two axes, so look for Q poke angles and moments when he has fewer axes instead of forcing fights. In the mid game, start fights by combining Miss Fortune R Bullet Time with your allies' crowd control, and work with your team to catch Draven when he is alone. In the late game, Miss Fortune has no mobility and struggles to position alone, so attack from the back line after your team holds off the engage.
Draven.teamfight: Cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain where Draven’s axe will land or along his approach path to slow him. When your team holds off the enemy engage and they cluster in one direction, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time right after your allies’ crowd control or from a safe position at maximum range. If R is unavailable, use E to block the engage and keep basic attacking from the back line.
Draven.watch: Early on, avoid trading while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes, since his basic attacks deal heavy damage. Draven E Stand Aside’s displacement can interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so position carefully while E is available. Draven R Whirling Death returns and can execute low-health enemies, so even after dodging it once, get completely out of both its outward and return paths.

Nilah.watch: Watch the path Nilah uses to close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream, and place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain along that path. Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range increases, so take another step back. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies so several of you are not pulled in together.
Nilah.build: In the early game, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Nilah’s main damage is physical, build armor first, but also build health to account for Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration. Slot Executioner’s Calling between your core items to counter Nilah’s healing.
Nilah.combo: Place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain along Nilah’s approach to slow her, then activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position. If your team’s area-of-effect crowd control catches Nilah first, save E and use R right away. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop your basic attack sequence and use ability damage.
Nilah.escape: Do not go in just because Nilah E Slipstream is down. Your chance to attack comes when Nilah dives in, has spent Nilah W Jubilant Veil, and is caught by your team’s crowd control. If Nilah R Apotheosis is also down, take position with less risk of being pulled in together.
Nilah.fight: When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop basic attacking and respond with abilities or wait for it to end. After Nilah dives in and is caught by your team’s crowd control, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain to keep dealing damage.
Nilah.laning: Look for an angle to hit Nilah behind a low-health front minion with Miss Fortune Q Double Up. For basic attack trades, alternate between hitting a minion and Nilah to make use of Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If you cannot see the jungler’s path, hold back on Q trades that push the lane. If you do push, clear the wave, then use Miss Fortune W Strut’s movement speed to secure river vision or recall.
Nilah.phase: In the mid game, build on your early lead by chaining your team’s crowd control into Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. In the late game, Miss Fortune has no mobility ability and only average range, so do not position alone; fight from the back line.
Nilah.teamfight: If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, do not group with your team. Wait for your team to absorb Nilah’s engage, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time when the enemy team is clustered in one direction. Cast R at the edge of its range, with a wall or brush behind you, or right after your team lands crowd control. When R is unavailable, block Nilah’s approach with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks from the back line.

Lucian.escape: Right after you make Lucian use E Relentless Pursuit is your chance to close the gap or catch him. However, if the enemy support's shield or heal, or a member of your team being immobilized, empowers Lucian's next two shots, don't take the trade; back off for a moment.
Lucian.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Lucian's main damage is physical and Miss Fortune has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor.
Lucian.combo: If Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down and you've let his first combo pass, slow his path with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a position where you can maintain the channel, such as maximum range or with a wall or bush behind you.
Lucian.fight: Counterattack after dodging Lucian's first combo, during the window when his abilities are down. Right after Lucian uses E Relentless Pursuit, slow his escape route with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and activate Miss Fortune W Strut for the attack speed you need to trade.
Lucian.laning: Alternate basic attacks between minions and Lucian to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Lucian is behind a low-health minion, look for a bouncing hit with Miss Fortune Q Double Up. This poke pushes the lane, so save Miss Fortune Q Double Up when you don't know the enemy jungler's path, and stay out of the piercing line of Lucian Q Piercing Light.
Lucian.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can seek a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up, but she must avoid Lucian's explosive first combo. In late game, Miss Fortune has no mobility and average range, so she has trouble positioning alone; build on the lead you gained in the early and mid game.
Lucian.teamfight: From the backline, use Miss Fortune E Make It Rain to slow Lucian E Relentless Pursuit's approach. After your team stops the engage and either the enemies bunch up in one direction or your team's crowd control lands, aim through their overlap and activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its displayed range, so avoid standing in a straight line behind the minion he's farming. If Lucian uses E Relentless Pursuit to close in for burst damage, let his first combo pass and counterattack after his abilities are down. Lucian R The Culling can't change aim direction while channeling, so dodge sideways instead of running straight back.

Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early lane, so don’t force fights that give her kills. Convert your lead in the mid game, and move with your team in the late game, when it’s hard to position alone.
Caitlyn.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Caitlyn’s primarily physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Caitlyn.combo: If Caitlyn stands behind a low-health front minion, kill it with Miss Fortune Q Double Up and aim to hit her with the bounce. In a fight, slow Caitlyn with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time.
Caitlyn.escape: Check your approach path before going in so Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap doesn’t root you.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for a trade just after Caitlyn clears the wave with Q Piltover Peacemaker. Don’t enter through a path covered by Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap.
Caitlyn.laning: Don’t give up kills by forcing fights into Caitlyn’s strong early laning; farm under your turret if needed. When poking, alternate basic attacks between a minion and Caitlyn to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. Hold back on Miss Fortune Q Double Up poke that pushes the lane when you have no vision.
Caitlyn.teamfight: From the back line, wait until your team holds off the enemy engage and the enemies cluster in one direction, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. To avoid having your channel interrupted, position at maximum range or with a wall or brush behind you, or cast right after your allies’ crowd control. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks.
Caitlyn.watch: Stepping on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you and increases the range of Caitlyn P Headshot, dealing heavy damage. Expect traps in brush and narrow paths, and change your route. When you see Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind an allied minion to take reduced damage.

KogMaw.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. His basic attacks also deal significant physical damage, so consider armor too, and keep in mind that stacking only health means taking more damage from Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage's max-health damage. No specific item purchases for Miss Fortune were provided in the source.
KogMaw.combo: If Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has ended and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is also down, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Start channeling from a position where you won't be interrupted, aiming through Kog'Maw and as many other enemies as possible.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so the window after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is your chance to close the gap. On the other hand, if Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active or you've been hit by Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, back off until that window passes.
KogMaw.fight: Back off while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, then close the gap and fight after it ends. Dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, then slow Kog'Maw with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and deal damage with the attack speed from Miss Fortune W Strut. Kog'Maw has no mobility and relatively low armor, so Miss Fortune's physical damage is effective against him.
KogMaw.laning: If Kog'Maw stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on that minion to look for a critical bounce. Alternate basic attacks between minions and Kog'Maw to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. Miss Fortune Q Double Up pushes the lane, so save it when you don't know the jungler's path and the vision situation; after pushing, use the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut to get river vision or recall.
KogMaw.phase: Kog'Maw gets stronger over time, so disrupt his farming in the early and mid game and build on your lead through towers and objectives. In late game, Miss Fortune has no mobility and has trouble positioning alone, so move with your team.
KogMaw.teamfight: After your team stops the enemy engage and the enemies gather in one direction, use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position in the backline. While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, let it run out instead of challenging him at long range, and look for a chance to catch him with an ally engage or crowd control. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, his attack range and damage based on maximum health increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle from behind minions; if it hits you, avoid fighting while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. When low on health, watch for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and move out of vision. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Aphelios.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several of you, and use Miss Fortune E Make It Rain to block his approach. When your team holds off the enemy engage and they cluster in one direction, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time at maximum range or from safe terrain.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mainly physical damage, and Miss Fortune has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to withstand his early damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If Aphelios’s healing extends fights, build armor first, then fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Aphelios.combo: In trades, attack a minion and then Aphelios to trigger Miss Fortune P Love Tap. To start a fight, slow Aphelios with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a position where he can remain in its area. If your team lands area crowd control first, save E and cast R immediately.
Aphelios.escape: Close the gap after dodging Aphelios’s Gravitum slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites root. When he isn’t holding Severum, he has fewer ways to escape, so look to block his retreat with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain as you engage.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon shown on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and trade when he has a weapon with low burst damage. Use Miss Fortune E Make It Rain to slow his escape route, but don’t force an approach within range of Aphelios’s root, since Miss Fortune has no escape ability.
Aphelios.laning: If Aphelios stands behind a low-health minion, hit him with Miss Fortune Q Double Up by bouncing it off the minion. Repeatedly pushing the lane with Q poke when you lack vision exposes you to ganks, so use Miss Fortune P Love Tap to alternate attacks between a minion and Aphelios instead.
Aphelios.phase: In the late game, use your early and mid-game lead to make plays, since you have no mobility and struggle to position alone.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, get out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. If you are marked by Calibrum, back off to avoid the follow-up attack. Keep your distance from allies when Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil is available.

Ashe.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Ashe’s mainly physical damage, since Miss Fortune has low armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow keeps interrupting Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, build Quicksilver Sash before your other defensive items.
Ashe.combo: In lane, repeat Miss Fortune P Love Tap by basic attacking a minion, then Ashe, then a minion. If Ashe stands behind a front minion, hit her with Miss Fortune Q Double Up by bouncing it off the minion. In a fight, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position.
Ashe.escape: Look to engage when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down too, there’s less risk of a stun interrupting Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Ashe has no ability to create distance, but Miss Fortune has no mobility either, so don’t approach while slowed by Ashe P Frost Shot.
Ashe.fight: Trade right after sidestepping Ashe W Volley. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then fight again once it ends. Miss Fortune has no mobility, so don’t force an approach on foot while slowed by Ashe P Frost Shot.
Ashe.laning: Alternate basic attacks between a minion and Ashe to make use of Miss Fortune P Love Tap. You can poke hard by killing a low-health front minion with Miss Fortune Q Double Up and bouncing it into Ashe behind it. When you can’t see the jungler’s path, don’t keep pushing with Miss Fortune Q Double Up; poke with basic attacks instead.
Ashe.phase: Look for a poke advantage early with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. In the late game, use your early and mid-game lead, since Miss Fortune has no mobility and struggles to position alone.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay in the back line and watch for Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow. When your team holds off the enemy engage and they cluster in one direction, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. You can use Miss Fortune E Make It Rain to block their approach or slow them before following up with your ultimate.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley slows in an area, so sidestep its cone and look to trade right after it’s used. Ashe P Frost Shot is refreshed with each basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow can stun you and interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so don’t start a skirmish out of vision while her ultimate is available.

Ezreal.combo: Go in briefly to make Ezreal use E Arcane Shift. When you go in again, slow his escape route with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. If your allies land crowd control first, save Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and cast R immediately.
Ezreal.escape: Look to engage right after Ezreal uses E Arcane Shift. Block his escape route with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and follow him with the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut.
Ezreal.fight: Alternate basic attacks between a minion and Ezreal to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. Rather than trading poke from a distance, make Ezreal use E Arcane Shift first, then close the gap and fight.
Ezreal.laning: If Ezreal stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on the minion and aim to hit him with the bounce. This poke pushes the lane, so save Q and poke with basic attacks when you can’t see the jungler’s path. If you’ve pushed the lane, use the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut to get river vision or recall.
Ezreal.phase: Look for an early poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. In the late game, it’s hard to position alone because you have no mobility and average basic attack range.
Ezreal.teamfight: From the back line, wait until your team holds off the enemy engage and the enemies cluster in one direction, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. To avoid having your channel interrupted, position at maximum range or with a wall or brush behind you, and look to cast right after your allies’ crowd control. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with a minion between you. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range because his next attack will deal additional damage. When your health is low, avoid the line of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage and retreat routes that overlap with your allies' routes.

Jhin.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Jhin’s mainly physical damage, since Miss Fortune has relatively low armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first.
Jhin.combo: If Jhin is reloading and you can safely close the gap, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If your team lands area crowd control first, save E and cast R immediately. Cast R at maximum range or with a wall or brush behind you, once Jhin is in the cone.
Jhin.escape: Look to engage after Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses or while Jhin is reloading. Jhin has no ability to create distance, so the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain helps you approach. If Jhin still has his final shot, back off even if you dodged W.
Jhin.fight: Track Jhin’s shots and start trading while he’s reloading or right after he fires one or two shots. Slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, close the gap, and pressure him with basic attacks. Delay your approach if he still has his final shot.
Jhin.laning: Alternate basic attacks between a minion and Jhin to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Jhin stands behind a low-health minion, kill the minion with Miss Fortune Q Double Up and hit him with the bounce. Stand away from low-health minions to avoid Jhin Q Dancing Grenade bouncing to you with increased damage after a kill. When you can’t see the jungler’s path, hold back on Q poke that pushes the lane.
Jhin.phase: In the mid game, use the advantage gained in lane to join your team around mid or objectives. In the late game, move with your team, since it’s hard to position alone.
Jhin.teamfight: Follow from the back line after an ally engages toward Jhin and absorbs Jhin W Deadly Flourish, Jhin R Curtain Call shots, and his traps. Slow an approaching enemy with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When your team holds off the enemy engage and their formation overlaps, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If your health is low, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, respond with E and basic attacks.
Jhin.watch: Back off while Jhin has his final shot, since it deals heavy damage. Right after Jhin hits you with a basic attack or you step on Jhin E Captive Audience, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and get out of its line. When your health is low, focus on dodging Jhin R Curtain Call.

Jinx.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Jinx’s mainly physical damage, since Miss Fortune has relatively low armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first.
Jinx.combo: In lane, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on a low-health minion to bounce it into Jinx behind it. In a fight, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position. If your team lands area crowd control first, save Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time immediately.
Jinx.escape: Look to close the gap when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. If Jinx W Zap! misses too, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and go in.
Jinx.fight: When Jinx pokes with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, look to trade when she has no minigun attack speed stacks. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, activate Miss Fortune W Strut to increase your attack speed, and attack.
Jinx.laning: Switch your target by attacking a minion and then Jinx to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Jinx stands behind a low-health minion, kill it with Miss Fortune Q Double Up and aim to hit her with the bounce. When you can’t see the jungler’s path, save Miss Fortune Q Double Up, which pushes the lane, and get vision first.
Jinx.phase: Look for an early poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. In the late game, Miss Fortune struggles to position alone, and don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.teamfight: From the back line, slow Jinx along her approach path with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. After your team holds off the enemy engage and the enemies group together, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from maximum range or with a wall or brush behind you so your channel isn’t interrupted, aiming in the direction where the most enemies overlap.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets deal damage around minions too, so don’t stand right next to them. Dodge the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! and the slow from Jinx W Zap! When health has been reduced, stay out of the range where Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! could finish off a target.

Kaisa.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand the early damage and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks.
Kaisa.combo: In a fight, slow Kai'Sa with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position. If your team lands area crowd control first, save E and cast R immediately.
Kaisa.escape: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, back off toward your allies until the mark disappears instead of trying to exploit that opening.
Kaisa.fight: If Kai'Sa looks ready to use Q Icathian Rain, stand beside an allied minion to spread out the missiles. Look to fight while Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down.
Kaisa.laning: Kill a low-health front minion with Miss Fortune Q Double Up and aim to hit Kai'Sa behind it with the bounce. When you lack jungle vision, don’t keep pushing with Q; alternate basic attacks between a minion and Kai'Sa to poke with Miss Fortune P Love Tap.
Kaisa.phase: In the late game, use the lead you gained in the early and mid game, since Miss Fortune struggles to position alone.
Kaisa.teamfight: From the back line, block Kai'Sa’s approach with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. After your team holds off the engage and the enemies cluster in one direction, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If Kai'Sa dives in with R Killer Instinct, focus her when your allies apply an immobilizing effect.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you can become the target of Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct’s engage. Right after being hit, back off toward your allies until the mark disappears. If your health is low and Kai'Sa P Second Skin has stacked on you, wait out of range for the stacks to fall off.

Kalista.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend.
Kalista.combo: Cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain toward Kalista to slow her, then activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally's area-of-effect crowd control lands first, save E and use R immediately. Aim the cone from maximum range or with a wall or bush behind you, accounting for the direction Kalista can escape.
Kalista.escape: Look to engage while Kalista R Fate's Call is down. Kalista P Martial Poise's leap relies on basic attacks, so take advantage of situations where you can push her out of range.
Kalista.fight: Alternate basic attacks between minions and Kalista to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. When Kalista starts her basic attack animation, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and use the attack speed from Miss Fortune W Strut when trading.
Kalista.laning: If Kalista stands behind a low-health minion, hit her with Miss Fortune Q Double Up bouncing off it. Q poke pushes the lane, so focus on passive-enhanced basic attacks when you can't see the enemy jungler's path. When spears have stacked on you, break vision by retreating behind a bush or wall.
Kalista.phase: In the mid game, use the advantage gained from pushing the opponent back in lane to join your team around mid or objectives. In the late game, Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone, so build on the advantage you gained earlier.
Kalista.teamfight: If Kalista's support stays close to her, watch for Kalista R Fate's Call and spread out in advance. Place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain along the enemy's approach, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time when your team has stopped the engage and the enemies bunch up in one direction. If R is unavailable, block the engage with E and basic attack from the backline.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend deals heavy damage after multiple spears stick, so stop fighting once stacks build and back away from the lane until the spears disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call can pull in and throw her support, so if the support stays close to Kalista, avoid the landing area and spread out.

Samira.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early. Samira's main damage is physical and Miss Fortune has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor.
Samira.combo: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune Q Double Up and basic attacks. If your team stops Samira's engage and the enemies bunch up in one direction, hold them with E, then activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally's area-of-effect crowd control lands first, save E and use R immediately.
Samira.escape: Right after you make Samira use E Wild Rush is your window to close the gap and attack. If the enemy support's engage ability is also down, you can fight with less concern about Samira following up with an engage through P Daredevil Impulse.
Samira.fight: When Samira walks in to make up for her short range, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, keep your distance, and poke. After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up and basic attacks. If Samira used E Wild Rush and no one died, attack during the moment when she has trouble dashing again.
Samira.laning: Alternate basic attacks between a minion and Samira to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Samira stands behind a low-health minion, kill the minion with Miss Fortune Q Double Up to look for bounce damage. When you lack vision, don't keep pushing the lane with Q; poke with basic attacks.
Samira.phase: Early on, use Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up to gain a poke advantage. In late game, Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone without mobility, so fight behind your team.
Samira.teamfight: After your team stops the enemy engage, activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position, aiming toward the clustered enemies. Place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in the path Samira E Wild Rush may take. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, be ready to interrupt it with your team's immobilizing crowd control or knockback, and don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, save Miss Fortune Q Double Up and basic attacks; attack after the spin ends. If you get hit by the enemy support's crowd control, Samira can dash in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge their engage ability first. If Samira is close and has landed several types of attacks, she may be able to use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so create distance.

Senna.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor because Senna's main damage is physical, and fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness.
Senna.combo: When poking, switch targets in this order—basic attack a minion, basic attack Senna, then basic attack a minion again—to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Senna stands behind a low-health minion, kill it with Miss Fortune Q Double Up to look for a critical bounce. In a fight, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally's area-of-effect crowd control lands first, save E and use R immediately.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses or is down is your chance to close the gap. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, retreat in case disguised enemies approach, and cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in the mist to block their engage.
Senna.fight: Poke Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul. Alternate basic attacks between minions and Senna to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap, and use the attack speed from Miss Fortune W Strut when trading. After dodging Senna W Last Embrace, if you get a chance to close the gap, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
Senna.laning: If Senna stands behind a low-health front minion, kill the minion with Miss Fortune Q Double Up to hit her with the bounce. Watch where Senna's souls appear and wait nearby to disrupt her collection. Miss Fortune Q Double Up pushes the lane, so save it when you don't know the enemy jungler's path and the vision situation; if you push, clear the wave, then get river vision or recall.
Senna.phase: Early on, use Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up to poke hard and stop Senna from collecting souls. In mid game, look for fights where Miss Fortune R Bullet Time and your team's crowd control work together, and move toward mid or objectives after pushing the lane. In late game, Senna P Absolution increases her range and attack damage, so don't try to position alone; build on the lead you gained in the early and mid game.
Senna.teamfight: From the backline, activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time after your team stops the enemy engage and they bunch up in one direction. The remaining shots disappear if Miss Fortune R Bullet Time's channel is interrupted, so use it at maximum range, with a wall or bush behind you, or right after your team's crowd control. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat or block the approach with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. If R is unavailable, respond with E and basic attacks.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so avoid the line running through Senna and her target. Block Senna W Last Embrace with minions; if it hits and marks you, immediately move away from your allies. After Senna hits you once, back off to avoid taking a second attack and prevent her from collecting Mist. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, disguised enemies may approach, so retreat or cast Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in its area.

Sivir.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor because Sivir's main damage is physical. If the healing from Sivir E Spell Shield is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Sivir.combo: Feint an engage to draw out Sivir E Spell Shield. After the shield is down, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position.
Sivir.escape: The moment Sivir E Spell Shield is down is your chance to catch her with an ability. Sivir has no blink-like mobility, so close the gap with your team when the effect of Sivir R On The Hunt has ended. If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights around terrain and vision instead of a long chase.
Sivir.laning: If Sivir stands behind a low-health minion, kill it with Miss Fortune Q Double Up to look for bounce damage. When you can't see the jungler's path, don't keep pushing the lane with Q poke; focus on basic attacks. If you need to leave the lane, account for Sivir's fast wave clear by pushing first or making sure an ally is ready to catch the wave.
Sivir.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can seek a poke advantage with P Love Tap and Q Double Up. In late game, Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone, so build on the lead you gained in the early and mid game.
Sivir.teamfight: From the backline, block the enemy approach with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. After your team stops the engage and the enemies bunch up in one direction, use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Activate R at maximum range, with a wall or bush behind you, or right after your team's crowd control. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, use the opening for an ally to catch Sivir.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on its way out and on its return, so if the first hit lands, move out of the return path. Watch out for the empowered basic attacks from Sivir W Ricochet, and don't use Miss Fortune's abilities hastily while Sivir E Spell Shield is available. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Smolder.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor against Smolder's main damage, but remember that armor can't block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Smolder.combo: In lane, switch targets in this order—basic attack a minion, basic attack Smolder, then basic attack a minion again—to use Miss Fortune P Love Tap. In a fight after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so right after he uses it is your chance to go in. Dodge Smolder W Achooo!, then close the gap and slow Smolder's escape route with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
Smolder.fight: Smolder is weak early, so pressure him first with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Make Smolder use E Flap, Flap, Flap, then close the gap and slow his escape route with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Use Miss Fortune W Strut for trades that need attack speed.
Smolder.laning: If Smolder stands in front of a low-health minion, look to poke him with a bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Disrupt Smolder's farming to delay his growth stacks, but save Miss Fortune Q Double Up, which pushes the lane, and poke with basic attacks when you can't see the jungler's path. If you push the lane, use the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut to get river vision or recall.
Smolder.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can gain a poke advantage, while Smolder is at his weakest before he has growth stacks. In mid game, use your early lead to take towers and objectives quickly. You'll be at a disadvantage as the game goes longer because of Smolder's permanent growth stacks, so play to end the game in mid game.
Smolder.teamfight: From the backline, activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time after your team stops the enemy engage and they bunch up in one direction. Use it at maximum range or with a wall or bush behind you to reduce the risk of the channel being interrupted. Place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in the path Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap may take, and move out of the flames from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!.
Smolder.watch: Being hit by Smolder W Achooo! slows you and adds to his growth stacks, so dodge by standing behind minions or moving sideways. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains true damage and an execute at enough stacks, so be especially careful when low on health. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of the flames before closing in again.

Tristana.build: If Tristana R Buster Shot’s stun keeps interrupting Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, buy Quicksilver Sash before other defensive items. The provided material does not specify which type of resistance to build.
Tristana.combo: Place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in advance along Tristana W Rocket Jump's engage path to slow her and make it harder to engage. If an ally’s area crowd control lands first, save E and cast R immediately.
Tristana.escape: Just after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down is your chance to close the distance or catch her. Don’t engage carelessly while Tristana W Rocket Jump and R Buster Shot are both available; wait until your allies have their crowd control ready.
Tristana.fight: Early on, alternate basic attacks between minions and Tristana to poke with Miss Fortune P Love Tap. Close the distance just after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, and use Miss Fortune W Strut for trades that need attack speed.
Tristana.laning: Avoid Tristana E Explosive Charge’s area damage by not standing next to allied minions. If Tristana stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on it to try to land the bounce damage. When using Q to push the wave, check the enemy jungler’s pathing and vision; after pushing, ward the river or recall.
Tristana.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can gain a poke advantage with P Love Tap and Q Double Up, then push the wave toward Tristana’s tower to pressure her last hits while she is weak early. In the mid game, build on your lead with Miss Fortune R Bullet Time and your allies’ crowd control. Tristana is hard to handle once her build is complete, so use your early and mid-game advantage to close out the game.
Tristana.teamfight: From the back line, place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in the path of Tristana W Rocket Jump. After your allies absorb the engage and enemies group together, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Cast it at the edge of its range or with a wall or brush behind you to avoid having your channel interrupted by Tristana R Buster Shot. If an ally goes down and Tristana W Rocket Jump could keep resetting, don’t leave squishy allies up front; retreat together.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is used to engage and chase, and its cooldown resets when she gets a takedown. Tristana R Buster Shot’s stun and knockback can interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so don’t cast R from the front line while both abilities are available.

TwistedFate.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Twisted Fate’s damage. Movement speed is also important for getting out of announced ability zones.
TwistedFate.combo: If Twisted Fate has used his Gold Card or an ally has applied crowd control, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use R Bullet Time. If an ally’s area crowd control lands first, save E and cast R immediately. Cast R toward grouped enemies from the edge of its range or with a wall or brush behind you.
TwistedFate.escape: Just after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is down is your chance to approach. Conversely, if you can anticipate his approach path from R Destiny, place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in advance to block it.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while he holds a Gold Card, and look to trade when he holds a Blue or Red Card. Just after Twisted Fate has fully spent W Pick a Card, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and attack with basic attacks. Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so Miss Fortune’s physical damage is effective.
TwistedFate.laning: Look to use Miss Fortune Q Double Up when it kills a low-health front minion and bounces to the Twisted Fate behind it. Q poke pushes the lane, so avoid it when you don’t know the jungler’s pathing and the vision situation; alternate basic attacks between minions and champions to make use of Miss Fortune P Love Tap. Stand behind minions to dodge Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, look for a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Q Double Up. In the late game, Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone, so build on the lead you gained early and mid game.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from the back line after your allies absorb the engage and enemies are funneled in one direction. If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is still available, stay far enough away that its stun can’t interrupt R. When R is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a Gold Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his range.

Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward first to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage together, and Twitch P Deadly Venom deals true damage, so building only one type of resistance won’t block all of it. The provided material does not establish the order for buying a particular resistance or item afterward.
Twitch.combo: If Twitch is revealed and an ally has applied crowd control, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time immediately. If there is no crowd control, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast R from a safe position.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment his camouflage ends is your chance to close the distance. Block his escape route with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and focus him with your allies.
Twitch.fight: Early on, use Miss Fortune P Love Tap by alternating attacks between minions and Twitch, and look for Miss Fortune Q Double Up when Twitch stands behind a low-health minion. Don’t keep trading inside Twitch W Venom Cask; leave it, and close the distance with your allies when Twitch’s camouflage ends.
Twitch.laning: Secure brush vision against Twitch Q Ambush, and alert your allies if Twitch disappears from lane. When you don’t know the jungler’s pathing, save Miss Fortune Q Double Up rather than using it to push the wave, and poke with basic attacks empowered by Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If you choose to push, clear with Q, then use the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut to ward the river or recall.
Twitch.phase: Early on, look for a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. In the late game, Miss Fortune has no mobility and has trouble positioning alone, so build on the lead you gained early and mid game.
Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out sideways instead of lining up with your allies so you don’t all get hit by its piercing basic attacks. When Twitch reveals himself, focus him in sync with your allies’ crowd control. Once your allies have absorbed the engage and enemies are funneled in one direction, use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch disappears with Q Ambush, avoid brush and narrow paths where you have no vision, and alert your allies. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands underfoot, leave it immediately. After taking several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate hits, even if you still have health.

Varus.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early on. Varus’s main damage is physical and Miss Fortune has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver or R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.combo: If Varus can’t easily leave a grouped formation, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally’s area crowd control lands first, save E and cast R immediately. Since Varus R Chain of Corruption could interrupt R, cast it from a safe position at the edge of its range or with a wall or brush behind you.
Varus.escape: After Varus R Chain of Corruption is down, you have a chance to engage without worrying about its root. While Varus aims Q Piercing Arrow, dodge sideways and approach. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you get close, use Miss Fortune E Make It Rain’s slow to keep him there.
Varus.fight: When Varus aims Q Piercing Arrow, dodge sideways while closing the distance. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use the attack speed from Miss Fortune W Strut to trade. If Blight has stacked on you, back off first and re-engage once the stacks expire.
Varus.laning: Alternate basic attacks between minions and Varus to make use of Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Varus stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on it to try to land the bounce damage. When you lack vision, don’t keep pushing the wave with Q; focus on poking with basic attacks.
Varus.phase: In the late game, use the advantage gained in the early and mid game to snowball, since there is no mobility ability and the range is average.
Varus.teamfight: From the back line, use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time after your allies absorb Varus’s engage and enemies are funneled in one direction. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, spread out so its tendrils don’t spread. Avoid fighting briefly while Varus is empowered by a takedown or assist. When Miss Fortune R is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and fight with basic attacks.
Varus.watch: If you’re hit by an ability while Blight stacks from Varus W Blighted Quiver are on you, you take bonus damage based on your maximum health. If Varus has hit you with several basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to expire. When Varus Q Piercing Arrow is aimed, sidestep its path; if an ally is bound by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so the tendrils can’t reach you.

Vayne.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early on. Build armor first against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn, but remember that armor can’t reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts. If Vayne E Condemn’s stun keeps interrupting Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, buy Quicksilver Sash before other defensive items.
Vayne.combo: Set up so a low-health minion is behind Vayne, then use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on that minion to deal bounce damage. In a fight, slow Vayne with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a position where Vayne E Condemn can’t interrupt it.
Vayne.escape: Just after you make Vayne use Q Tumble, close the distance while her mobility is down or catch her out. Approach from open ground away from walls so you can avoid Vayne E Condemn’s stun.
Vayne.fight: Just after you make Vayne use Q Tumble is your chance to close the distance and fight. Slow Vayne’s engage path with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and use the movement speed built up on Miss Fortune W Strut while you haven’t taken damage to control the distance. Activate Miss Fortune W Strut when you need attack speed for a trade.
Vayne.laning: Early on, make use of Miss Fortune P Love Tap by alternating basic attacks between minions and Vayne. If Vayne stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up to poke with the bounce. Miss Fortune Q Double Up pushes the wave, so don’t use it freely without vision when you don’t know the enemy jungler’s pathing. If you pushed to disrupt Vayne’s farming, use the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut to ward the river or recall.
Vayne.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can gain a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up, and Vayne is easy to pressure while her early-game health and armor are low. In the mid game, turn the lead gained with Miss Fortune R Bullet Time and your allies’ crowd control into towers and objectives. In the late game, Vayne becomes harder to handle as she gets attack speed and penetration items, so use your early and mid-game advantage to close out the game.
Vayne.teamfight: From the back line, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time after your allies absorb the engage and enemies are funneled in one direction. Don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a narrow passage, so Vayne E Condemn can’t knock and stun you. Cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time when at least one condition is met: you’re at the edge of its range, you have a wall or brush behind you, or an ally has just applied crowd control. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, block Vayne’s engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and hold on with basic attacks.
Vayne.watch: Don’t fight with a wall behind you, since being knocked into one and stunned by Vayne E Condemn is dangerous. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on maximum health when enough attacks hit the same target, so get out of her range before it triggers. During Vayne R Final Hour, she briefly becomes invisible after Vayne Q Tumble, so use Miss Fortune Q Double Up after she becomes visible again.

Xayah.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early on. Xayah’s main damage is physical and Miss Fortune has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Xayah.combo: If Xayah stays in one place and her ultimate is down, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally’s area crowd control lands first, save E and cast R immediately.
Xayah.escape: If three or more feathers on the ground have a return path that passes through you, sidestep first to avoid Xayah E Bladecaller’s root.
Xayah.fight: Keep trades with Xayah short and reposition so feathers don’t pile up underfoot.
Xayah.laning: If Xayah stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up to kill the minion and try to land the bounce damage. Q poke pushes the lane, so save it when you don’t know the jungler’s pathing and lack vision; alternate basic attacks between minions and Xayah to make use of Miss Fortune P Love Tap.
Xayah.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can look for a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. In the mid game, build your lead when Xayah R Featherstorm is down and around your allies’ crowd control. In the late game, fight from the back line because Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone.
Xayah.teamfight: After your allies absorb the engage, if enemies are funneled in one direction, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from the edge of its range or from safe terrain. If Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, don’t rush into the engage; block her approach path with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by at least three returning feathers. If three or more feathers form a line between you and Xayah, sidestep immediately. Xayah R Featherstorm can avoid engages and crowd control, so don’t start a fight without a clear opening while her ultimate is available.

Yasuo.build: In the early game, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Miss Fortune has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke. If Yasuo W Wind Wall has disappeared and your team lands crowd control, activate Miss Fortune R Bullet Time right away. If your team has no crowd control, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use R from the safe edge of its range.
Yasuo.escape: Your chance to attack comes right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Look to engage with your team’s crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so do not go deep just because he has used it once.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then start trading damage. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so keep your distance and look for a chance to attack. If he catches you, you can easily be hit repeatedly, so place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain along Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s approach.
Yasuo.laning: Thin the wave and pull it toward your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use. If Yasuo stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on that minion to aim for the bounce damage. When you cannot see the jungler’s path, do not keep pushing the lane with Q; focus on basic attack poke.
Yasuo.phase: In the early game, Miss Fortune aims to gain a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. In the late game, Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone, so build on the lead you gained in the early and mid game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Keep your distance in the back line until your team absorbs Yasuo’s engage. Place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain along his approach, and use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time from a safe position when the enemy team is clustered in one direction or caught by your team’s crowd control. If R is unavailable, block the engage with E and attack with basic attacks.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to close the gap, so do not assume you are safe behind minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, he can knock you up with a tornado, so watch for the sound and visual effect and sidestep out of its line. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, so save Miss Fortune Q Double Up until the wall disappears.

Zeri.build: Hold on with Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first since Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal primarily physical damage. Be careful about relying heavily on health alone, since Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on maximum health and executes low-health enemies.
Zeri.combo: After Zeri E Spark Surge is down, slow her with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and follow with Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. Cast your ultimate from the edge of its range or with a wall or brush behind you, and angle the cone with Zeri’s escape direction in mind.
Zeri.escape: Just after you make Zeri use E Spark Surge, close the distance while her mobility is down. Avoid positions against a wall or in a narrow passage so you can dodge the slow from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser.
Zeri.fight: While Zeri’s basic attack range is short and her early kill pressure is low, poke first with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Just after you make Zeri use E Spark Surge is your chance to close the distance. Activate Miss Fortune W Strut when you need attack speed for a trade.
Zeri.laning: Alternate basic attacks between minions and Zeri to trigger Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If Zeri stands behind a low-health minion, use Miss Fortune Q Double Up on it to try to land the bounce damage. Q poke pushes the wave, so save Q and poke with basic attacks when you don’t know the enemy jungler’s pathing and lack vision.
Zeri.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can gain a poke advantage with Miss Fortune P Love Tap and Miss Fortune Q Double Up, so build a lead before Zeri completes her core items. In the late game, Zeri’s mobility makes her hard to catch, and Miss Fortune has trouble positioning alone, so use your early and mid-game advantage to close out the game.
Zeri.teamfight: From the back line, place Miss Fortune E Make It Rain in the path of Zeri E Spark Surge. Once your allies absorb the engage and enemies are funneled in one direction, cast Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase her on foot. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is unavailable, block the engage with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and hold on with basic attacks.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads and deals more damage when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or face her head-on in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing terrain, so push her toward open ground away from walls when trying to catch her. Zeri gets faster as she lands hits with R Lightning Crash, so don’t chase her on foot.

Ziggs.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ziggs’s damage. Prioritize movement speed too, so you can get out of the landing areas of Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and R Mega Inferno Bomb. The provided material does not specify which items to buy first.
Ziggs.combo: When Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, slow him with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, then use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time. If an ally’s area crowd control lands first, save E and cast R immediately. Aim R from a position where it won’t be interrupted, and choose your angle before Ziggs can escape.
Ziggs.escape: Just after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is your chance to engage. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield also blocks your path, approach from a direction without mines or wait for them to disappear. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, check for an escape route over a wall before engaging.
Ziggs.fight: Close the distance and start trading just after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. Use Miss Fortune W Strut’s attack speed increase for the trade, and avoid approaching along paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Miss Fortune’s physical damage is effective against Ziggs’s low armor.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, use Miss Fortune P Love Tap by alternating basic attacks between minions and Ziggs. If Ziggs stands behind a low-health minion, look for bounce poke with Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Q poke pushes the wave, so save it when you don’t know the enemy jungler’s pathing. If you push the wave, ward the river or recall.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, Miss Fortune can look for a poke advantage with P Love Tap and Q Double Up. In the mid game, use the advantage you’ve built to snowball; in the late game, fight behind your allies so Miss Fortune, who has no mobility ability, doesn’t have to position alone.
Ziggs.teamfight: Don’t enter through a path blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield; slow Ziggs’s approach path with Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Use Miss Fortune R Bullet Time after your allies absorb the enemy engage and enemies are funneled in one direction or caught by crowd control. Since Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb can arrive from far away, don’t group up in one spot in front of an objective.
Ziggs.watch: If you step on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, its slow makes it easier to get hit by his other abilities, so go around it or wait for it to disappear. When the marked area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move farther from the center of the explosion, even if you can’t leave the area entirely. While Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, be aware that it can interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time or let Ziggs escape over a wall.
